recommendations: IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED: Address 3 critical security findings
- Data Encryption at Rest: Implement AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data at rest
- SQL Injection Protection: Use parameterized queries and input validation for all database operations
- Administrative Access Controls: Implement strong admin controls, MFA, and monitoring
HIGH PRIORITY: Address 8 high-severity findings within 1 week
Implement regular security scanning and monitoring
Conduct regular security training for development team

findings.title: Password Policy Configuration
findings.description: Review password complexity requirements and enforcement
findings.impact: Weak passwords increase risk of unauthorized access
findings.recommendation: Implement strong password policy with minimum 12 characters, complexity requirements

findings.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
findings.description: Verify MFA implementation for all user accounts
findings.impact: Lack of MFA increases account takeover risk
findings.recommendation: Implement TOTP-based MFA for all user accounts

findings.title: Session Security
findings.description: Review session timeout and security configurations
findings.impact: Insecure session management may lead to session hijacking
findings.recommendation: Implement secure session timeouts and regeneration

findings.title: Data Encryption at Rest
findings.description: Verify encryption of sensitive data in databases and storage
findings.impact: Unencrypted data may be exposed in case of breach
findings.recommendation: Implement AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data at rest

findings.title: Data Encryption in Transit
findings.description: Verify TLS configuration for all data transmission
findings.impact: Unencrypted data transmission may be intercepted
findings.recommendation: Enforce TLS 1.3 for all communications, disable weak ciphers

findings.title: Data Classification
findings.description: Review data classification and handling procedures
findings.impact: Improper data handling may lead to compliance violations
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive data classification scheme

findings.title: Firewall Configuration
findings.description: Review firewall rules and network segmentation
findings.impact: Improper firewall configuration may allow unauthorized access
findings.recommendation: Implement principle of least privilege for firewall rules

findings.title: Service Exposure
findings.description: Identify unnecessarily exposed network services
findings.impact: Exposed services increase attack surface
findings.recommendation: Close unused ports and services, implement network segmentation

findings.title: SQL Injection Protection
findings.description: Verify parameterized queries and input sanitization
findings.impact: SQL injection vulnerabilities may lead to data breach
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries and input validation for all database operations

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Protection
findings.description: Review output encoding and CSP implementation
findings.impact: XSS vulnerabilities may lead to session hijacking
findings.recommendation: Implement proper output encoding and Content Security Policy

findings.title: API Rate Limiting
findings.description: Verify rate limiting implementation for API endpoints
findings.impact: Lack of rate limiting may enable DoS attacks
findings.recommendation: Implement appropriate rate limiting based on endpoint sensitivity

findings.title: API Authentication
findings.description: Review API key management and JWT token security
findings.impact: Weak API authentication may lead to unauthorized access
findings.recommendation: Implement secure API key rotation and JWT best practices

findings.title: Security Event Logging
findings.description: Verify comprehensive logging of security events
findings.impact: Insufficient logging may hinder incident response
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive security event logging and monitoring

findings.title: Log Integrity Protection
findings.description: Review log tampering protection mechanisms
findings.impact: Log tampering may hide malicious activity
findings.recommendation: Implement log integrity protection and centralized logging

findings.title: GDPR Compliance
findings.description: Review GDPR compliance requirements implementation
findings.impact: Non-compliance may result in significant fines
findings.recommendation: Implement data subject rights, privacy by design, and breach notification

findings.title: SOC2 Type II Compliance
findings.description: Review SOC2 trust service criteria implementation
findings.impact: Non-compliance may affect customer trust and contracts
findings.recommendation: Implement SOC2 controls for security, availability, and confidentiality

findings.title: Dependency Vulnerabilities
findings.description: Check for known vulnerabilities in dependencies
findings.impact: Vulnerable dependencies may be exploited by attackers
findings.recommendation: Regularly update dependencies and use vulnerability scanning tools

findings.title: SSL/TLS Configuration
findings.description: Review SSL/TLS cipher suites and protocol versions
findings.impact: Weak SSL/TLS configuration may allow man-in-the-middle attacks
findings.recommendation: Disable weak ciphers and enforce TLS 1.3

findings.title: Security Headers
findings.description: Verify implementation of security headers: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy
findings.impact: Missing security headers may enable various web attacks
findings.recommendation: Implement all recommended security headers

findings.title: Role-Based Access Control
findings.description: Review RBAC implementation and privilege escalation protection
findings.impact: Inadequate access controls may lead to unauthorized data access
findings.recommendation: Implement comprehensive RBAC with principle of least privilege

findings.title: Administrative Access Controls
findings.description: Review administrative account security and monitoring
findings.impact: Compromised admin accounts may lead to complete system compromise
findings.recommendation: Implement strong admin controls, MFA, and monitoring
